history.alreadyCancelled: The selected sales have already been cancelled; they cannot be cancelled again.
history.alreadyHidden: The selected sales have already been removed from the list.
history.alreadyListed: The selected sales are already in the list.
history.alreadyCancelledShort: The selected sales have already been cancelled
history.incompleteTitle: Sales history loaded incompletely — partial list
history.totalsNote: Cancelled sales are not included in net totals. Sales removed from the list remain in the totals because they were not cancelled{hidden}.
history.hiddenCount: ({count, select, 1 {1 record removed from the list} other {{count} records removed from the list}})
history.cancelTitle: Cancels the sale; quantities of products still in stock are added back
history.hideTitle: Removes from the visible list only; stock does not change
history.selectedCount: {count, select, 1 {1 sale selected} other {{count} sales selected}}
history.onlyHide: {reason}; only “Remove from List” can be used.
history.archiveNote: Sales removed from the list. Restoring them does not change stock or sale status.
history.emptyArchive: No sales removed from the list.
history.otherCategory: + {count, select, 1 {1 product from another category} other {{count} products from another category}} (actions apply to the whole sale)
history.confirmCancel: The selected sales will be cancelled. The sold quantities of the related products still in stock will be added back. Do you confirm?
history.confirmHide: The selected sales will be removed from the visible list. Stock quantities will not change and the sales will not be cancelled. Do you confirm?
history.confirmUnhide: The selected sales will be returned to the visible list. Stock quantities and sale status will not change. Do you confirm?
history.noteMulti: Note: {count, plural, one {# of the selected sales also contains} other {# of the selected sales also contain}} products from other categories; the action applies to the WHOLE sale (its items in all categories).
history.noteIneligible: {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} will not be processed.
